**Hi, I'm Omar Osama 👋**  
**Computer Science student @ Cairo University · Networking · Cybersecurity · Software Engineering**  
I'm a Computer Science student passionate about Networking, Cybersecurity, and Software Engineering. I'm building my networking foundations through CCNA studies and documenting my hands-on labs, configurations, and learning journey in a dedicated GitHub repository. Alongside that, I'm strengthening my problem-solving skills through Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA), solving programming problems and maintaining a separate repository to track my progress. I'm also exploring Linux administration, Python scripting and network automation, penetration testing, and security tools such as Nmap and Wireshark.  
My goal is to turn what I learn into practical projects, build a strong technical portfolio, and grow toward a career in Network Engineering and Cybersecurity.

**🚀 Featured Projects**  
**🎟️ Premium Event & Venue Management System**  
ASP.NET Core MVC C# SQL Server ADO.NET  
Full-stack web app for event scheduling, attendee registration, ticketing, venue allocation, and staff assignments. I designed the relational database (ERD and normalization) and built the CRUD and ticket-registration workflows with Razor Views and Dependency Injection.  
   
 [View repository](https://github.com/Umarosama/YOUR-EVENT-REPO "https://github.com/Umarosama/YOUR-EVENT-REPO")  
**💰 Cash Pilot: Personal Finance Management System**  
Java Java Swing SQLite MVC  
Desktop app for budgeting, transaction tracking, financial reporting, and goal management. I led a team of three developers and applied UML modeling, testing, SOLID principles, and the Observer pattern to keep the system maintainable and well documented.  
   
 [View repository](https://github.com/Umarosama/Cash-Pilot "https://github.com/Umarosama/Cash-Pilot")
